paper_level_summary_zh: 该文在相关工作中提及 [23]，指出其使用RFID进行窃听，但需要预安装标签，且与毫米波方法相比分辨率较低。属于普通相关工作引用，未明确评价其亚毫米级能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room.
